title: Share of Africa's borders running along a parallel or a meridian, by study
description: Bar chart. Alesina, Easterly and Matuszeski (2011): 80 percent of African borders follow lines of latitude and longitude. Barbour (1961): 44 percent are parallels or meridians. Paine, Qiu and Ricart-Huguet (2024): such lines are the main feature of 18 percent of bilateral borders. Barbour and Alesina are as Paine and colleagues quote them.
